d: At Rosewood Doha, we create an environment where passion meets purpose – and where careers have meaning.

Guided by our philosophy of Relationship Hospitality and our culture of Make the Place, we believe in enriching lives, starting with yours. We empower you to bring your true self, grow with confidence, curate the extraordinary and leave your legacy.
You’ll be part of a diverse, inclusive and supportive community that invests in your development, celebrates achievements and inspires you to Discover Your Calling.
Together, we push boundaries, explore the uncharted and shape the future of luxury lifestyle experiences.

Rosewood Doha is a landmark destination inspired by Qatar’s coral reefs, bringing together ultra-luxury hospitality, residential living, culinary experiences, holistic wellness, differentiated retail and events within one integrated ecosystem. The property includes a 155-key hotel, 162 serviced apartments and 276 private residences, alongside a diverse collection of restaurants and lounges, expansive event spaces and curated lifestyle experiences. Our destination also houses Asaya, Qatar’s first members-only social wellness club, complemented by Rosewood’s signature Manor Club for Club Room and Suite guests.

Since opening in July of 2025, Rosewood Doha has been recognized with multiple international and regional accolades, including distinctions from the Michelin Guide, Forbes Travel Guide and Qatar Tourism - reflecting the scale, ambition and standards of excellence behind the destination. As part of the global Rosewood Hotels & Resorts portfolio, the property represents a new generation of luxury that goes beyond traditional hospitality into lifestyle, community and experience-driven destinations.
q: We believe exceptional work deserves exceptional care. At Rosewood Doha, we offer a thoughtfully designed associate experience that supports your wellbeing, growth and life beyond work. This includes:

d: For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

Our Utility Cleaners play an important role in support of a number of vital hotel functions. At our hotels these associates may work across departments (e.g., kitchen, food and beverage, laundry) to support cleaning needs. Whether preparing fresh clean linen and spotless dining ware for guests to enjoy, operating and maintaining cleaning equipment and tools (e.g., dish washing machines, hand wash stations, linen washers and dryers), or transporting dishware or linens across the hotel, these associates do whatever it takes to get the job done.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards, develop and maintain positive working relationships with other employees and departments, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

d: We are looking for a skilled Linux System Administrator with 4+ years of relevant experience in managing and maintaining enterprise Linux environments. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), automation tools, infrastructure operations, and security compliance. Saudi nationals are preferred; however, Arabic-speaking candidates will also be considered.
q: 3–4 years of relevant experience in Linux System Administration.
Hands-on experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) administration and Red Hat Satellite.
Proficiency in Ansible, Ansible AWX, Bash scripting, and cron-based automation.
Good understanding of Linux security hardening, CIS benchmarks, MBSS baselines, SELinux, auditd, and vulnerability remediation.
Experience administering DNS, NTP, Systemd, LVM, NFS/CIFS, and troubleshooting infrastructure issues.
Exposure to VMware virtualization and container technologies such as Docker and Podman.
Understanding of disaster recovery, system migration, and high-availability concepts.
Saudi nationals are preferred; Arabic-speaking candidates will also be considered.
r: Manage enterprise RHEL environments, including server provisioning, configuration, patching, upgrades, and decommissioning using Red Hat Satellite.
Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks, administer Ansible AWX, and automate operational tasks using Bash scripting and cron.
Implement security and compliance standards, including CIS benchmarks and MBSS security baselines, while managing SELinux, auditd, SSH policies, security agents, and CVE remediation.
Administer and troubleshoot infrastructure services, including DNS, NTP, Systemd, LVM, and NFS/CIFS, addressing performance, storage, and connectivity issues.
Support VMware environments and containerized workloads using Docker and Podman.
Assist with disaster recovery, system migrations, and high-availability implementations to ensure infrastructure reliability and operational continuity.

d: Volantes Technical Recruitment are currently supporting a leading international aviation and logistics organisation with their search for a Technical Services Engineer – Powerplant to join their team in Al Muharraq, Bahrain, on a full-time basis.

You will support the Technical Services Manager – Powerplant in maintaining the continued airworthiness of aircraft engines and auxiliary power units (APUs). Your responsibilities will include technical support, engine health monitoring, material management and oversight of engine shop visits, working closely with maintenance teams, manufacturers, vendors and aviation authorities.
q: A minimum of three years’ experience in Technical Services Powerplant Engineering.
Graduate qualification or Licensed Aircraft Maintenance Engineer status under EASA, FAA or ICAO Type II requirements.
Experience reviewing and compiling engine and APU LLP Back-to-Birth trace packages.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel.
GE CF6-80C2 CAMO technical experience would be a distinct advantage.
Experience using My Boeing Fleet, General Electric technical resources and GE AirVault would be advantageous.
Experience with TRAX, AMOS or similar maintenance management software would be advantageous.
Experience using Engine Health Monitoring software, particularly General Electric systems, would be advantageous.
Experience interpreting flight data through a Flight Data Monitoring System would be advantageous.
If you are looking for your next opportunity and meet the requirements above, we would love to hear from you.
Apply now or contact Volantes Technical Recruitment for further details.
r: Provide engineering assistance and troubleshooting support, liaising with aircraft, engine and APU manufacturers to resolve technical issues.
Assess technical documentation issued by airworthiness authorities, manufacturers and vendors.
Manage powerplant material requirements, including forecasting consumption, sourcing materials, reviewing vendor options and providing technical approval for purchases.
Review material documentation and Life Limited Part (LLP) Back-to-Birth (BTB) trace packages before purchase.
Maintain accurate and current LLP BTB records for each engine and APU.
Manage material movements throughout engine and APU shop visits, ensuring accurate and timely updates within TRAX.
Ensure compliance with materials receiving inspection procedures.
Evaluate new aircraft for powerplant and APU airworthiness compliance, identifying any required modifications.
Research powerplant and APU technical data to support Service Bulletin assessments.
Assess engineering requirements, requisitions and quotations for the overhaul and repair of powerplant and APU components.
Manage the complete engine shop visit process, from removal planning and work scope preparation through to invoice and release documentation reviews.
Visit off-wing maintenance providers to carry out shop visit inspections.
Manage soft-life requirements for Line Replaceable Units (LRUs) and non-LLP components.
Provide technical and advisory support to Maintenance, Quality, Stores and Flight Operations teams.
Take responsibility for the Engine/APU Health Monitoring programme, compiling trend reports and recommending maintenance actions.
Monitor engine and APU on-wing life, LLP life limits and Airworthiness Directive limitations.
Evaluate potential engines and APUs for procurement.
Monitor preservation and storage requirements for spare engines and APUs.
Assess manufacturers’ Alert Service Bulletins, Service Bulletins, Service Letters and Fleet Team Digest notifications, recommending actions to improve reliability.
Assess Airworthiness Directives and future powerplant and APU requirements mandated by aviation authorities.
Liaise with vendors and Civil Aviation Authorities.
Perform other reasonable duties as required.
